task.title: Inspect exact recurrence occurrence history through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/971 to expose exact occurrence history as deterministic read-only JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence identity before opening only existing storage read-only.
Emit revision-ordered persistence, claim, release, and materialization JSON or history null for an absent coordinate.
Fail with one stable diagnostic and no partial output for selected corruption while isolating evidence outside the selected coordinate.

attempts.diagnostic: The first CLI lifecycle test failed because occurrence-history was not a recognized recurrence subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added focused CLI coverage for lifecycle JSON, absence, validation, storage failure, and corruption isolation.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded adapter.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented read-only store delegation and deterministic typed JSON while keeping CLI serialization separate from kernel lifecycle validation.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 971 in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests, ADR-0086, and synchronized scheduler documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Review identified weak corruption fixtures and a selected-coordinate isolation gap that could permit a silent no-op setup.
attempts.patch: Asserted each corruption update affected exactly one row and added selected, unrelated-recurrence, and same-recurrence out-of-coordinate coverage; resolved all review threads.

attempts.diagnostic: Rate-limited false greens were excluded across follow-up heads; the final exact head received genuine CodeRabbit review after cooldown with no unresolved threads.
attempts.patch: Kept auto-merge disabled until local verification, CI, substantive review, and exact-head thread resolution all agreed.

outcome.summary: Issue 971 delivered deterministic exact occurrence-history JSON with strict validation and no added lifecycle authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 972 exact head

lessons: Corruption fixtures must assert that their storage mutation actually selected one row or a passing isolation test can be meaningless.
The CLI should serialize canonical kernel evidence rather than duplicate lifecycle replay.
Exact history inspection adds no write, discovery, clock, worker, dispatch, permission, retry, or execution authority.
